recreation_brief:
1. Create a blank slide and set the background fill to solid light gray (RGB approx. 240,240,240 / #F0F0F0).
2. Insert a text box centered horizontally on the slide, positioned so its top edge is around 40% of the slide height.
3. Type the first line: [3] Inverse of High Dimension
4. Type the second line on a new line: (non-singular) Matrix
5. Format both lines in a bold sans-serif font (e.g., Arial or Calibri) at a large size (approx. 44-54 pt), colored dark red (RGB approx. 192,0,0 / #C00000), and center-align the text.
6. Insert an oval shape in the top-right corner, sized roughly 40-50 px in diameter.
7. Fill the oval with bright yellow (RGB 255,255,0 / #FFFF00) and add a thin dark outline if desired.
8. Add the text '22' inside the oval, centered, in a small dark/black font.
9. Do not add any other shapes, bullets, or decorative elements.
